Periodic Report (Form 802) -- Secretary: CORRECTED 2026-08-30 -- replaces the previously ambiguous, uncited 'State Registration Filings' entry. This is the correct and only mechanism for board-of-directors/officer identification, distinct from the Management Certificate. Neither the POA Management Certificate (Property Code Sec. 209.004) nor the condo Management Certificate (Sec. 82.116) requires naming the board of directors -- both require only a single managing agent or designated representative's contact information. Board/officer identification, when the Secretary of State requests it, happens through the Tex. Bus. Orgs. Code Chapter 22 nonprofit Periodic Report mechanism (Form 802) -- filed only once every 4 years, and only upon SOS request, not annually. Do not conflate this with an annual franchise tax/PIR filing, which is the for-profit/taxable-entity mechanism, not the nonprofit one -- a properly tax-exempt POA does not file an annual PIR the way a for-profit corporation does.
